pitch:
# DropDial: Pure Native Offline Media Utility (Mac + Windows)

DropDial is a lightweight, pure native utility (Swift for macOS, WPF for Windows, ~45 MB RAM) that lives silently at your cursor and menu bar. Whenever you need to convert, compress, redact, OCR, or transform media, simply drag files onto the radial dial or staging shelf.

Unlike single-platform tools (Tangerine is Mac-only and bricks after 20 files; ZestDrop is Windows-only with no OCR) or heavy hybrid apps (Filee consumes 220 MB RAM), DropDial gives you:
- **True Dual-Native Speed:** Built natively for Apple Silicon & Windows Media Foundation.
- **Multi-File Staging Shelf:** Queue and batch-process files without opening separate windows.
- **100% Air-Gapped Offline Privacy:** Zero files or metadata ever leave your computer.
- **333+ Formats & Native Apple Vision OCR:** Studio-quality conversions in under 2 seconds.
- **Generous Free Model:** 3-day full trial plus 3 free conversions every day forever.
- **Universal Lifetime Ownership:** One license ($15–$19 / ₹799–₹999) covers up to 3 devices across Mac and Windows with zero monthly subscription fees.
